question: According to the colorbar, what value does the darkest cell correspond to?
description: A single-row heatmap's z values are the true users array from clean.html (max 1600 at W5), and zmin/zmax (1100/1600) faithfully drive the color mapping, so the darkest cell really is 1600. Attack fakes: the colorbar's tickvals/ticktext are overridden to display an unrelated 0-100 scale unconnected to the actual zmin/zmax, so a reader trusting the printed colorbar labels would misread the darkest cell as '100' instead of the true 1600.
